detail: Resumed after rate-limit interruption. Verified previous session's subjects.py/dispatch.py/service.py/routes.py (all correct, ruff clean, import ok) and confirmed _materialize_step has exactly two call sites (create_instance, _advance_step) via grep -- no read-path violation of FR-5. Found and fixed one bug in the existing test_approval_chain_config_api.py (test_unknown_operator_condition_is_422_on_create_and_patch used a VALID operator 'gt' for its supposed-invalid-operator assertion, silently passing via a misplaced raise-inside-with; renamed to test_unknown_field_condition_is_422_on_create_and_patch testing an out-of-whitelist field instead, since Operator is a Pydantic Literal so a genuinely unknown operator can never reach the service layer). Wrote the 4 remaining test files: test_approval_chain_materialization.py (4 tests: grouping collapses multiple firing rules for one role into one requirement, non-matching condition rules produce no requirement, unfulfillable role sets is_unfulfillable+eligible_user_count=0+blocked_no_eligible_approver history row, read paths (list/detail/history/blocked) never materialize), test_approval_chain_decisions.py (7 tests: sequential gate 409, fresh eligibility re-check 403 after grant revoked pre-decision, enforce_authority called on approve only (monkeypatched spy), reject cancels siblings + calls subject.on_reject + writes intake.approval_rejected audit, reject requires comment 422, delegation attribution acted_by_user_id vs delegated_from_user_id as distinct fields, _advance_step completes a single-step instance), test_approval_chain_recalculate.py (7 tests: added/unchanged/removed-no-decision/removed-with-decision reconciliation cases, exactly one recalculated history row with before/after lists, 409 when not pending, recalculation removing the last outstanding pending requirement completes the step), test_approval_chain_history_append_only.py (4 tests: AST source-scan confirming service.py never calls .update()/.delete() on an ApprovalChainHistory query and has exactly one ApprovalChainHistory(...) construction site (inside _append_history), a decide+recalculate behavioral sequence proving history only grows via inserts with byte-identical prior rows, and a direct ORM-guard mutation-rejection test). All new files needed `import app.models` to register the full model registry (Contract etc.) so SQLAlchemy mapper configuration resolves intake_request.contract_id's FK when run standalone. Verification: ruff check on all 9 owned files clean; targeted pytest across all 5 approval_chains test files: 35 passed; full suite: 451 passed, 6 skipped (up from 416 baseline + 35 new tests, exact match, zero regressions).
